source_full_text: And the look of death departed from him, and he grew strong and rosy once more. But the little child lay as white and still as if she had been dead. They laid her in the cradle and wept bitterly, for they thought that by the next morning she would be lost to them. At sunrise the old man returned and asked after the sick man. He is as well as ever answered the king's son. And where is your baby in the cradle yonder, and I think she is dead Replied the father sadly.

reference_text: 死亡的神情从他脸上消失了，他又变得强壮而红润起来。但那个小婴儿却像死了一样，苍白而静止。他们把她放在摇篮里，悲痛地哭泣，因为他们以为到了第二天早晨，她就会永远离开他们。黎明时分，老人回来了，问起那个病人的情况。国王的儿子回答说：“他和往常一样健康。”“那你们摇篮里的孩子在哪里？我觉得她已经死了。”父亲悲伤地回答。
